annotations.identity: Goblin caves: low, damp and crowded, lit by fires, glowworms and fungus. Drums carry through the rock. Warboss Grutt is uniting the tribes; every map is goblin ground.
annotations.poi: Scout Camp; Wolf Pens; Sapper Camp; New Tunnels; Flooded Passages; Glowworm Grotto; Rhys's Camp; Mushroom Farms; Hexer's Den; Shaman's Fire; Drum Hall; Grutt's Throne; Holt's Cell; Sealed Stair; Silver Seam.
annotations.structure: Two ways in: forest-mouth from the hills and flooded-caves from the mire. Friendly footholds: Arlo's scout camp (forest-mouth area_4) and Captain Rhys's camp (fungus-deeps area_1), each a small safe spot. Deeper is harder: the sapper tunnels and fungus deeps (6-7), the drum halls (8), Grutt's hall (9-10), with the sealed stair down to the dungeon.

cave-bat.description: A leathery cave bat with a wingspan wider than a goblin is tall.
cave-bat.name: Cave Bat

powers.description: Bites and laps at the wound, healing itself.
powers.name: Leeching Bite

powers.description: An ear-splitting screech that throws off everyone's aim.
powers.name: Screech

annotations.intent: Ambient cave beast: ambushes from stealth in the Gnawdeep's side passages and webbed dead ends, in pairs. Web slows hard but briefly.

cave-spider.description: A black spider as big as a wolf, waiting in the dark above the tunnel.
cave-spider.name: Cave Spider

powers.description: Spits a sticky web that pins the target in place.
powers.name: Web

powers.description: A bite that pumps venom into the wound.
powers.name: Venom Fang

goblin-archer.description: Hangs back and looses crude arrows at whoever it's angry at.
goblin-archer.name: Goblin Archer

powers.description: A heavy shot with a barbed head.
powers.name: Barbed Arrow

powers.description: An arrow to the leg that slows the target.
powers.name: Crippling Shot

goblin-cutter.description: A scrappy goblin with a rusty blade and no plan.
goblin-cutter.name: Goblin Cutter

powers.description: A quick stab to the gut.
powers.name: Gut Jab

powers.description: Swings faster for a few seconds.
powers.name: Scrappy

goblin-hexer.description: A wizened goblin with a bag of bones and grudges.
goblin-hexer.name: Goblin Hexer

powers.description: A curse that saps the target's strength.
powers.name: Hex of Weakness

powers.description: A slow rot that eats at the target.
powers.name: Withering Curse

powers.description: A bolt of murky shadow.
powers.name: Shadow Bolt

goblin-mender.description: Mutters war-chants and slaps poultices on its packmates.
goblin-mender.name: Goblin Mender

powers.description: Slaps a poultice on the most wounded goblin nearby.
powers.name: Mend Wounds

powers.description: A rousing chant that sharpens the whole pack's spite.
powers.name: War Chant

powers.description: Spits a wad of thorns.
powers.name: Thorn Spit

goblin-sapper.description: Throws bombs, badly but enthusiastically, and explodes when killed.
goblin-sapper.name: Goblin Sapper

powers.description: A lit bomb that bursts into flame, splashing everyone near where it lands.
powers.name: Firebomb

powers.description: Explodes when killed, blasting everyone close by.
powers.name: Last Fuse

goblin-sneak.description: A knife-artist that slips past the front line to stab healers in the back.
goblin-sneak.name: Goblin Sneak

powers.description: A vicious stab to an exposed back.
powers.name: Backstab

powers.description: A dirty blow that leaves the target dazed.
powers.name: Cheap Shot

goblin-wolfrider.description: A goblin on a mangy wolf, fast enough to run down anyone who kites.
goblin-wolfrider.name: Goblin Wolfrider

powers.description: Charges through the target, knocking it off balance.
powers.name: Ride Down

powers.description: The wolf howls, and both of them get faster at biting.
powers.name: Howl

annotations.balance: A named quest boss, tuned by hand at 1.5x a solo's HP (450). Little direct damage; its curses do the work. Below half health it adds Curse of Frailty, so cleanse or burst it down.
annotations.intent: L3's named hexer (quest 4, The Hexer), in the hexer's den in the Gnawdeep: the goblin cursing the tunnels. S12's hexed totems are its work, and S12's apprentice is its pupil.

hexer-nagg.description: A wizened goblin hung with bone charms, whose curses have soured half the Gnawdeep's tunnels.
hexer-nagg.name: Nagg the Hexer

powers.description: A curse that saps the target's strength.
powers.name: Hex of Weakness

powers.description: A slow rot that eats at the target.
powers.name: Withering Curse

powers.description: A bolt of murky shadow.
powers.name: Shadow Bolt

powers.description: Wounded, it spits a curse that makes every blow land harder.
powers.name: Curse of Frailty

annotations.balance: A named quest boss, tuned by hand at 1.5x a solo's HP (450). Fire Ward shields the goblins with her; below half health she stokes herself (x1.3 damage).
annotations.intent: L3's named shaman (quest 6, The Shaman's Fire), at the shaman's fire in the Gnawdeep, with a few goblins around her. Keeper of the fire the tribes gather at.

shaman-brazza.description: The goblin shaman who keeps the tribes' great fire, and can call it down on anyone she dislikes.
shaman-brazza.name: Brazza, Keeper of the Fire

powers.description: A bolt of fire from the great fire's coals.
powers.name: Firebolt

powers.description: A ring of fire bursts out around her.
powers.name: Flame Wave

powers.description: Wraps her kin in a ward of heat.
powers.name: Fire Ward

powers.description: Wounded, she feeds the fire with her own blood.
powers.name: Stoke the Fire

annotations.balance: A named quest boss, tuned by hand at 1.5x a solo's HP (450) and the open solo damage budget; below half health he enrages.
annotations.intent: L3's boss (quest 12), in Grutt's hall at the bottom of the Gnawdeep, with his guards. His orders come from the Goblin King below; he answers to him, and the sealed stair down is behind his hall.

warboss-grutt.description: The red-skinned warboss uniting the Gnawdeep's tribes, loud, scarred and much cleverer than he looks.
warboss-grutt.name: Warboss Grutt

powers.description: A heavy thump that leaves the target dazed.
powers.name: Skull Thump

powers.description: A wide axe swing through everyone in front of him.
powers.name: Cleave

powers.description: A bellow that rallies his guards.
powers.name: Rallying Roar

powers.description: Bloodied, he flies into a rage.
powers.name: Warboss's Fury

annotations.balance: A named quest boss, tuned by hand at 1.5x a solo's HP (450). He's meant to be fought with his worgs, so his own damage is light; below half health Blood Frenzy speeds up the whole pack.
annotations.intent: L3's named mob (quest 9), in the Gnawdeep's wolf pens: the wolfriders' leader. Place him with two or three worgs in his group; his howls buff them. No mounted token exists, so his token is on foot.

wolf-master.description: The goblin who breaks the Gnawdeep's wolves into mounts, and never goes anywhere without a few of them.
wolf-master.name: The Wolf-Master

powers.description: A crack of the wolf-whip that hobbles the target.
powers.name: Whip Crack

powers.description: A jab with a hooked goad.
powers.name: Goad

powers.description: Howls with his wolves; the pack fights harder and faster.
powers.name: Pack Howl

powers.description: Bloodied, he whips himself and the pack into a frenzy.
powers.name: Blood Frenzy

worg.description: A cunning, malicious wolf; goblins and orcs ride them to war.
worg.name: Worg

powers.description: A ripping bite that leaves the target bleeding.
powers.name: Savage Bite

powers.description: A menacing snarl that shakes the target's nerve.
powers.name: Snarl
